verified: Initial frame had blank visibility, count, identity, and box fields.
Setting visibility to No left count and identity blank.
Drawing a box left visibility, count, and identity unchanged; the frame remained incomplete.
Changing visibility to Yes left count and identity blank; the frame remained incomplete.
Manually entering count 1 and identity Yes completed the drawn frame (1/17).
Reload preserved the explicit labels, box, and 1/17 completion state.
Changing visibility back to No left count 1, identity Yes, and the box unchanged and marked the row incomplete.

In standard Chrome, a fresh packetKey exported a 34-row CSV with exactly one explicitly entered synthetic absent-frame row (visible=false, count=0, identity=false, no box); all other annotation fields remained blank.

An earlier scratch-key export included two extra smoke rows from browser-local state; the final clean-key CSV was re-exported and retained as the QA artifact. No packet ZIP or human-return CSV was modified.
The synthetic absent-frame value deliberately did not describe the visible object in that frame; it tested CSV serialization only and is invalid as an annotation of the image.
